question.en: Will erasing her name save her?

narration.en: Eva signed in. The night porter had already gone.
narration.zh: Eva 簽了名。夜班管理員已經離開。

narration.en: At midnight, the house visitor came for names left in that book.
narration.zh: 午夜，屋裡的訪客會來找名字還留在簿上的人。

narration.en: One minute left. She rubbed out every trace of her name.
narration.zh: 剩下一分鐘。她擦掉名字的每一道痕跡。

narration.en: The shape outside disappeared. Eva closed the book and breathed.
narration.zh: 門外的身影消失了。Eva 合上簿子，鬆了口氣。

narration.en: At the chime, the book fell open to the page underneath.
narration.zh: 鐘響時，簿子掉落，翻開了底下那一頁。

narration.en: Her name was still there. So was her visitor.
narration.zh: 她的名字還在。她的訪客也在。
